title: 3Sum
oneLinerQuestion: Find all unique triplets in an array that sum to zero.
explanation: Sort the array first. For each element i, use two pointers l and r. Check triplets systematically: if sum < 0, increment l to increase the sum; if sum > 0, decrement r to decrease the sum; if sum == 0, record the triplet and shift both pointers past duplicates.
pseudoCode:
FUNCTION threeSum(nums):
    SORT(nums), res = []
    FOR i FROM 0 TO LENGTH(nums) - 3 DO:
        IF i > 0 AND nums[i] == nums[i-1] THEN CONTINUE
        l = i + 1, r = LENGTH(nums) - 1
        WHILE l < r DO:
            sum = nums[i] + nums[l] + nums[r]
            IF sum == 0 THEN:
                APPEND [nums[i], nums[l], nums[r]] TO res
                WHILE l < r AND nums[l] == nums[l+1] DO l = l + 1
                WHILE l < r AND nums[r] == nums[r-1] DO r = r - 1
                l = l + 1, r = r - 1
            ELSE IF sum < 0 THEN l = l + 1
            ELSE r = r - 1
        END WHILE
    END FOR
    RETURN res
END FUNCTION
